d:
Baby This Baby That is the high-energy party track from Tu Mera 22 Main Tera 22, with Mika Singh's voice riding on a classic Yo Yo Honey Singh beat. It's the kind of Punjabi banger that turned the film's soundtrack into a dance-floor staple.
This new video gives the song a fresh look while keeping the same Mika and Honey Singh energy that made it a hit.
Song Credits
Song: Baby This Baby That
Singer: Mika Singh
Music: Yo Yo Honey Singh
Lyrics: Alfaaz
Label: Speed Records
